node-1.label: A 49-year-old woman presented with healed ulcers on the lower lip and nasal dorsum, a nonhealing ulcer on the left lateral infraorbital area, and later left eye restriction and full-thickness lower eyelid defect

node-2.label: Facial ulcers over several years were described as 'scratches' developing over weeks to months into red, indurated, tender ulcers that finally crusted and healed

node-3.label: Review of systems was positive for dry mouth, Raynaud phenomenon, morning joint pain, mild hand and ankle swelling, and dysphagia

node-4.label: Physical examination revealed healed ulcers on lower lip and nasal dorsum and a nonhealing ulcer in the left lateral infraorbital area

node-5.label: Later eye findings included diplopia, sense of fullness below left eye, restriction of left eye into hypotropic and exotropic position, full-thickness defect through lateral lower eyelid, and exposed conjunctiva and bony orbital rim
